reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Ohio
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    "Is the term 'Writ of ejectment' used to refer to the order from the court
     to the authorities to remove a tenant?"
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario (facts + summary)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(ohio).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The term being asked about (normalized to an atom)
scenario_asked_term(writ_of_ejectment).

% What the asked term is alleged to refer to (in plain logical form)
scenario_target_concept(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual statement is present.
   This "summarizes the scenario" so it can be reused in reasoning. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(ohio),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_asked_term(writ_of_ejectment),
    scenario_target_concept(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant).

% -----------------------------
% Statute translation (Ohio Rev. Code  1923.13 (2021))
% -----------------------------

/* Ohio Rev Code  1923.13 (A) & (B) (2021)
   When a judgment of restitution is entered in an action under Ch. 1923,
   at plaintiff's request, the court shall issue a "writ of execution on the judgment".
*/
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_official_term(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment).

/* Ohio Rev Code  1923.13(A) (2021)
   The writ commands an officer to remove the defendant and give the plaintiff restitution (possession). */
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_effect(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, commands_removal_of_defendant).
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_effect(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, commands_restitution_of_premises).

/* Ohio Rev Code  1923.13(A) (2021)
   The writ is directed to law-enforcement / court officers (examples given in the form). */
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_directed_to(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, constable).
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_directed_to(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, police_officer).
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_directed_to(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, sheriff).
statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_directed_to(2021, writ_of_execution_on_judgment, authorized_bailiff).

/* Ohio Rev Code  1923.13(A) (2021)
   Duty trigger: judgment of restitution entered + plaintiff (or agent/attorney) requests issuance.
   (We encode the duty abstractly; the question is terminological, but we still represent the duty.)
*/
statute_ohio_1923_13_duty_to_issue_writ(2021, judgment_of_restitution_entered, plaintiff_requests, writ_of_execution_on_judgment).

/* NOTE:
   The provided statutory text uses "writ of execution on the judgment" and does NOT state that
   this order is called a "writ of ejectment." We intentionally do not add any such synonym rule
   because the task is to encode only what is in the provided statutes.
*/

% -----------------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% -----------------------------

/* The concept asked about: "order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant"
   is matched to the statute's writ when (1) it is an official term in the statute and
   (2) it has the removal-command effect. */
legal_concept_court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant(State, Year, Term) :-
    State = ohio,
    statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_official_term(Year, Term),
    statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_effect(Year, Term, commands_removal_of_defendant),
    statute_ohio_1923_13_writ_directed_to(Year, Term, _AnyOfficer).

/* "Term X is used to refer to concept Y" iff X is an official statutory term that matches the concept. */
legal_term_used_for_concept(State, Year, Term, court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant) :-
    legal_concept_court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant(State, Year, Term).

% -----------------------------
% Answer computation (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_asked_term(Term),
    scenario_target_concept(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant),
    legal_term_used_for_concept(State, Year, Term, court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_asked_term(Term),
    scenario_target_concept(court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant),
    \+ legal_term_used_for_concept(State, Year, Term, court_order_to_authorities_to_remove_tenant),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the term 'Writ of ejectment' used to refer to the order from the court to the authorities to remove a tenant?
